quote: we propose a novel multi-task language model that also provides rationales for decisions in medicine. ... we explore latent attention layers to generate rationales.
The model is evaluated according to ... rationale precision ...
sentences are presented sequentially to an expert physician ...
We outline a novel evaluation protocol that measures the quality of the extracted rationales by leveraging clinical domain expertise.
guideline: The physician is instructed to decide whether each sentence in the rationale contains information that helps explain the model decision, based on predefined utility criteria for each task.

Sentences are presented sequentially to an expert physician who chooses at each step to either predict patient outcome or check the next sentence. To avoid arbitrary judgements, we work with the physician to tailor the definition of utility for each task.
